recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and taste due to lack of standardized recipes and kitchen execution issues.
recommendations.action: Implement strict standardized recipes, step-by-step plating guides, and comprehensive kitchen training during off-peak hours to ensure consistency.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly reduce food complaints and improve overall dish consistency, leading to higher customer satisfaction scores.

recommendations.issue: High prices and poor value perception due to menu pricing misalignment with portions or experience.
recommendations.action: Conduct a menu engineering audit to review portion sizes, ingredient costs, and perceived value, adjusting prices or enhancing presentation accordingly.
recommendations.expected_impact: Align customer expectations with pricing, reducing value-related complaints and encouraging repeat visits.

recommendations.issue: Unhelpful or rude staff attitudes caused by insufficient service training and high stress during peak shifts.
recommendations.action: Roll out mandatory hospitality and de-escalation training workshops for all front-of-house staff, alongside optimized shift scheduling to manage stress.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improve staff morale and attentiveness, resulting in warmer guest interactions and fewer negative service reviews.
